artworks.title: The Rise
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Ruth K. Henschel in memory of her husband, Charles R. Henschel
artworks.description: This painting shows a person in a rowboat on calm water, fishing. The boat is positioned horizontally across the painting, and the person in it faces the left, looking forward. Their left hand holds the side of the boat while the right holds a long fishing pole that is placed over their shoulder. They wear long-sleeved brown garment and a tan hat with cloth panels that cover their neck and chin. Their skin is a light red color, and they appear to have a gray mustache. In the background there are dense dark green trees, and in the upper left corner a sliver of glowing sky in shades of orange and yellow is visible. Around the boat is dark blue water, with a hint of the yellow sky reflected in the bottom left corner.

artworks.title: Salt Kettle, Bermuda
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Ruth K. Henschel in memory of her husband, Charles R. Henschel
artworks.description: We look across a coral-pink beach that curves around a royal-blue bay, under a glimmering, pale blue sky in this horizontal watercolor landscape. The area of the beach closest to us is cast under a pale, plum-purple shadow. The beach curves away from us and to the right, like a backward C. At the curve, a short distance from us, a bank of emerald-green vegetation and a scrubby, dark green tree leads back to a low, grassy hill. A pair of two-story buildings with oyster-white walls and bright white roofs perch on the spit of land opposite us, across the water. Pale pink boats are pulled up onto the beach in front of and to our left of the buildings. The buildings and the green hill reflect in the water, which laps against the sand closest to us with bands of azure blue. More loosely painted buildings line the horizon, which comes about a third of the way up the composition. Two brick-red smudges to our left could be people standing at the water’s edge in the distance. The sky above has puffy white clouds against a brilliant blue sky. The artist signed the painting in the lower left, “HOMER.” In the lower right, the location and date are written in dark gray, “Salt Kettle Dec 1899.”

artworks.title: Under a Palm Tree
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Ruth K. Henschel in memory of her husband, Charles R. Henschel
artworks.description: This painting depicts a woman standing upright next to a thin tree trunk, with one arm folded across her chest and the other hanging down by her side. Her body is facing us, but her head is turned to look off to the left. She has long dark hair partially covered by a plaid shawl, and wears a white skirt, brown apron, red and white blouse, and gray shoes with red bows or flowers on them. She has light brown skin, deep-set eyes, a small nose, and lips set in a neutral expression. Greenery surrounds her, with some red flowers or leaves visible. The sky visible beyond the trees is off-white, and the ground is light brown.

artworks.title: Girl with Hay Rake
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Ruth K. Henschel in memory of her husband, Charles R. Henschel

artworks.title: The Road to Calvary
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 40.5 x 58.1 cm (15 15/16 x 22 7/8 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a crowd with various figures in different poses. The drawing is detailed and filled with characters, some wearing armor and weapons. One central figure is carrying a large cross, surrounded by others in distress. The background shows an architectural cityscape with tall buildings. The drawing is rich with line work and shading.

artworks.title: Cervara
artworks.description: The image depicts a scenic view with a slightly elevated perspective. In the foreground, there are figures in traditional clothing near a large rock formation. The horizon is high, showing a hilltop with buildings, suggesting a village on the cliffs. The brushstrokes capture the texture of the terrain and foliage. The color palette includes earthy tones—beiges, browns, and greens—contrasted with blue sky. Trees cast shadows, and a pathway curves towards distant rocky cliffs.

artworks.title: Via Porta Pinciana, Rome
artworks.description: The image depicts a street in Rome, with buildings lining a curving road leading into the city. The drawing is in a monochrome palette, highlighting the architectural details. A path with stones and shadows leads up, flanked by buildings. A figure stands at the entrance of one building. The horizon is subtly portrayed where the street converges in the distance. Buildings and an Italian pine tree are in the distance. Soft clouds fill the sky, contrasting with the buildings. Tall trees and a stone tower are on the right side of the composition.

artworks.title: Veduta di Campagna vincino a Gamberaia
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a winding path leading towards buildings on a hill in the distance. Close by is a chapel or shrine surrounded by trees. A man is leading a donkey carrying goods, and other figures are present in the scene. The trees are detailed with individual leaves. The color scheme is monochromatic, highlighting the linework and shading.

artworks.title: Seascape with a Fortified City at Right, Islands at Left and a Cottage in the Foreground
artworks.description: The image shows a panoramic landscape view from a slightly elevated perspective. The horizon is around one-third from the top of the image. Various landforms like hills and structures resembling a town or city with a spire are visible. The sketch features fine, linear brushstrokes outlining the hills and architectural elements against the sky. Muted earth tones are used for colors, giving a monochrome look with a warm undertone. Vegetation, rocky terrain, and open water are depicted closer to the viewer, hinting at a rugged landscape. In the distance, there are outlines of an island or peninsula and buildings, suggesting a coastal region with a harbor or bay.

artworks.title: Estuary with a Fortified Seaport at Left and Cliffs at Right
artworks.description: The image is a sketch of a landscape from an elevated point of view, showing a city and its surroundings. The horizon is positioned in the upper third, with a line of buildings and a prominent spire in the city. Above the horizon, there are clouds with horizontal brushstrokes. Close to us, there are loosely sketched figures near a waterway. The technique is light pencil strokes for shading, with cross-hatching for depth and darker areas. The color palette is primarily tan and gray tones on paper.

artworks.title: Woman Carrying a Basket
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. William Benedict
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing upright with one hand holding up a large round basket on their head. The person is facing slightly to the side and their facial features are obscured by shadows. They are dressed in long, loose-fitting garments and are wearing a cap. The person has a cape or shawl and an apron tied around their waist. They are wearing simple shoes and the basket on their head appears to contain various items. The background is plain ground textures with no distinguishable objects.

artworks.title: Portrait of M. Sebastien Le Prestre de Vauban
artworks.artist: Louis Bernard after François de Troy
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. William Benedict
artworks.description: The image depicts a man in a classic portrait style. He is shown from the upper body in a three-quarter view, with a defined face featuring strong eyes, a straight nose, and full lips. His long curly hair extends to his shoulders. He is wearing elaborate armor with intricate detailing, as well as a ruffled white garment at the neck. The background is dark, emphasizing the subject, and there is an inscription at the bottom of the image.

artworks.title: Girl with a Mask
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. William Benedict
artworks.description: The image depicts the upper body of a person, positioned to the left with a gentle smile. The person has curly hair styled around the head and wears a draped garment covering the shoulders and head resembling a shawl or veil. They hold a dark half-mask with eye openings. The background is plain with faint pencil shading, a signature and the date "1820" to the left of the person.

artworks.title: Disparate conocido (Well-Known Folly)
artworks.medium: etching and burnished aquatint [trial proof printed posthumously before 1877]
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. William Benedict
artworks.description: This is a drawing of several figures in an intense and dramatic scene. In the foreground, a standing figure on the right side is interacting energetically with a group of figures gathered to the left. The standing figure is dressed in dark clothing with a billowing cloak and is holding an elongated object. The group to the left is closely gathered and reacting to the actions of the figure on the right; one figure is seated and appears distressed or contemplative. The scene conveys powerful emotion and suggests themes of confrontation or tension in a dark setting. The textured shading in the background highlights the contrast between light and shadow on the figures.

artworks.title: Old Man in the Manner of Rembrandt
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 15.4 x 11.5 cm (6 1/16 x 4 1/2 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. William Benedict
artworks.description: The image shows a person sitting with their body slightly angled. They have a mustache and a beard, and they are wearing a large turban. The person's attire is elaborate with detailed patterns or embroidery, especially near the chest area. The background is a textured, dark surface.

artworks.title: The Martyrdom of Saint Sebastian
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash on laid paper
artworks.description: This drawing depicts figures, a horse, and draped fabric. It is executed with loose, flowing lines and expressive use of ink wash. In the center, there is a rearing horse and several intertwined figures, possibly in motion. The figures are sketchily drawn, emphasizing curves and gestures over details. On the right, additional figures are suggested with draped fabric, hinting at a grand setting or narrative. The style is reminiscent of sketches from the Baroque period.

artworks.title: Landscape with Log House near a River
artworks.artist: Dutch 17th Century, formerly Jacques de Gheyn II
artworks.description: The image depicts a woodland scene with a waterway, rolling hills, a windmill, trees, a wooden structure, and a figure crossing a bridge. The artwork features detailed engraving using black ink on a light background to create texture and depth.

artworks.title: The Battle of the Amazons [recto]
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a battle scene. The drawing shows a chaotic and intense battle involving female warriors and male soldiers on horseback. The composition is densely packed with dynamic figures in various fighting poses. The figures are depicted in a classical style, with muscular physiques and flowing garments. The scene takes place in front of a large architectural structure with columns. There are numerous weapons, shields, and horses intricately detailed throughout the scene.

artworks.title: The Water's Course
artworks.description: The image shows a view from a wooded area, with dense clusters of trees filling the scene. The horizon is obscured by foliage, and the trees create a path for the eye towards the center of the image. The etching displays intricate lines detailing the texture of tree bark, leaves, and undergrowth. The color scheme is primarily sepia and brown, giving a timeless quality to the landscape. Trees in the foreground reach upward, forming a natural arch, while those in the distance recede into the background.

artworks.title: Eve
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman's upper body to her knees. The woman is seated, facing left with her head tilted. She has a serene expression, delicate facial features, and wavy hair down her back. She is partially draped and holding onto a branch with large leaves. In the background, there is a detailed landscape with a large tree on the left, and rolling hills, clouds, and light on the right. Text is included in the lower corner.

artworks.title: The Raising of the Cross
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over touches of black chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a religious scene depicting a crucifixion. The drawing is done in a monochrome ink wash, with lines that suggest dynamic movement. In the center, there is a cross being raised by several figures while a person is depicted on the cross. There are additional figures gathered around, some are engaged in efforts to raise the cross, while others are positioned at various parts of the composition, including someone on horseback on the right and a group of people on the left under a tree.

artworks.title: "Susanna Smuls" and "Leuye Joost"
artworks.artist: Johannes and Lucas van Doetechum after Pieter Bruegel the Elder
artworks.description: There are two separate oval portraits placed side by side within a rectangular frame. Each portrait shows the head and shoulders of an elderly person. In the left portrait, the person is slightly turned towards the right with deep-set eyes and wears a hood covering the head and neck. In the right portrait, the individual faces more to the left with distinct facial features, a focused expression, short curly hair under a brimmed hat, and both are dressed conservatively up to the neck. The background consists of horizontal lines, and there are no other intricate patterns or elements besides the frame and ovals.

artworks.title: "Beleefde Goossen" and "Prijne Lecker-tants"
artworks.artist: Johannes and Lucas van Doetechum after Pieter Bruegel the Elder
artworks.description: The image features two portrait engravings side by side, showing the upper bodies of an elderly man and an elderly woman. Both individuals are positioned in profile within oval frames. The man on the left has deep-set eyes, prominent cheekbones, and a slightly protruding chin, with expressive facial lines that indicate advanced age. His hair is mostly covered by a textured cap, with only a few locks visible, and he wears a simple draped garment. The woman on the right displays similar signs of aging, with pronounced wrinkles, particularly around the eyes and mouth, and she has a slight downward gaze. Her head is covered by a hooded cloth, likely part of her attire, and her garment appears modest and plain. There is no visible jewelry or objects being held by either figure. The background of the image consists of evenly spaced horizontal lines that fill the rectangular space around the ovals.

artworks.title: "Hans Onvertsaeght" and "Koen Slock-speck"
artworks.artist: Johannes and Lucas van Doetechum after Pieter Bruegel the Elder
artworks.description: The image shows two oval-framed portraits of a man. One portrait shows him in a semi-profile view, while the other displays a more frontal perspective. The man has distinct facial features, including a noticeable nose, deep-set eyes, and visible lines and wrinkles. He has curly hair under a cap and wears a garment with a collar. The portraits are set against a background of horizontal lines and are rendered in a monochromatic, etched style on a paper-like surface.
